Ama Adepa

Something I made for you

Ama Adepa

My Ama. My baby girl.

My dear Ama Adepa ❤️,

Sometimes I still think about how funny it is that I met you the way I did. Out of all the people I could have met, I happened to see you on ZeeMee, started talking to you, and somehow that simple conversation grew into something that has become very special to me. At the time, I honestly didn’t know who this beautiful girl on my screen would eventually become in my life, but looking back now, I can genuinely say that meeting you has been one of the beautiful things that has happened to me. I really bless the day I found you, and I appreciate all the memories, conversations, laughter, arguments, jokes, and everything else that has come with knowing you.

I really cherish you, Ama. I love how you carry yourself, your kindness, how much you care about people, your beautiful smile, and of course those teeth that I am always talking about 😂❤️. There are so many little things about you that I have come to appreciate, even some things you probably don’t realize I notice. Whenever I look at you, I see a beautiful young woman with so much potential, and I genuinely want to see you do well in life. I want to see you achieve the things you talk about, become successful, take care of yourself and your family, and one day look back at everything you’re going through now and realize that it was only preparing you for something better.

I know your internship at the hospital hasn’t exactly been the best experience lately, and I know there are people and situations there that can make going to work stressful. But please, Ama, try not to focus too much on anybody there. You know why you are there, so just do what you have to do, learn what you can, get the experience you need, finish your internship, and come home. Don’t allow anybody’s attitude to destroy your mood or make you carry unnecessary stress around. People will always behave the way they want to behave, and sometimes trying to understand everybody will only make you more tired. Focus on yourself and what you went there to accomplish. This internship is temporary, and before you know it, you will be done with it and moving on to something else.

And whenever it gets frustrating, just remember that I’m here rooting for you. Even though I’m far away and I can’t physically be there when you have a bad day, I still care about what you’re going through, and I genuinely pray that things get easier for you. I pray that God gives you the strength and patience to finish everything well and that He continues opening doors for you. Sometimes things don’t happen exactly when or how we expect them to, but that doesn’t mean they won’t eventually work out.

One of the biggest things I’m praying for is that by next year, everything works out and you are able to come and join me here in the United States. I really want that for you, not only because I want you close to me, but because I want you to have the opportunity to pursue your education, experience new things, and continue building the future you want for yourself. I pray that you get into a good school with the financial support you need, that your visa gets approved, and that everything that needs to fall into place actually does. I know there are many things involved and nothing is guaranteed, but I have faith that God can make a way for you.

I still remember those conversations we used to have about how our lives would be here, especially all our New York Christmas plans 😂❤️. We talked about being in New York during Christmas, seeing all the lights and decorations, going around together and enjoying ourselves. I still think about those conversations sometimes. Imagine us actually getting there one day after talking about it for so long. You’ll probably be complaining about the cold while I’m pretending that I’m perfectly fine even though I’m also freezing 😂. We’ll take plenty of pictures, eat, walk around, disturb each other, and definitely dance. And I’m serious about the dancing oo. We are going to dance like two crazy people 😂❤️. I don’t care if we’re in the kitchen, our room, outside somewhere, or just randomly playing music. I already know I’ll be pulling you up to dance even when you don’t want to.

Those are honestly some of the things I look forward to the most. Of course, I want both of us to succeed, graduate, get good jobs, travel, and accomplish the big things we dream about, but I also look forward to the simple things. Being able to see each other without planning around distance, going somewhere together, cooking, going to church, having random conversations late at night, laughing about stupid things, supporting each other when something isn’t going well, celebrating when something finally works out, and just enjoying life together. I think sometimes those ordinary moments become the ones you remember the most.

And please, before you think I have forgotten, I have absolutely not forgotten about my twins 😂😂. I am still waiting for them. Whatever happens, you are still going to give me my twins oo. This matter has been pending for too long, but I haven’t closed the case. 😂❤️

Ama, even though things between us have not always been perfect, I still appreciate you very much. We’ve had misunderstandings, difficult moments, distance, and times when things probably felt different between us, but meeting you has never been something I regretted. You have been a blessing in my life, and I will always appreciate that. I know I can also be very annoying sometimes 😅. I can be stubborn, worry too much, ask too many questions, and sometimes probably disturb your peace small 😂, so please continue having patience with me. Everything comes from the fact that I genuinely care about you.

I want you to take good care of yourself for me. Eat properly, rest whenever you get the chance, pray, and don’t put every problem in this world on your head. You don’t always have to solve everything at once. Keep doing your best and trust God with the things you cannot control. I pray for your health, your peace, your education, your family, your future, and all the things you are working toward. I pray that God protects you wherever you go and gives you wisdom in the decisions you make. I also pray that He continues blessing your parents, your siblings, your grandmother, and everyone around you. Whenever you talk to them, greet them for me too.

Most importantly, don’t let what you’re experiencing now make you forget the person you are. Keep your kindness and that caring heart of yours. Keep believing that something better is ahead. I really believe you have so much potential, Ama, and I hope one day you will see yourself the way the people who genuinely love you see you. There are still so many things waiting for you in life, and I want you to keep going until you reach them.

And now I should probably explain why you’re reading all of this on an actual website instead of me just sending you another long WhatsApp message like I normally do 😂.

As you know, I’ve started learning coding, and part of learning is actually building things and practicing what I’m being taught. I could have created some random website about myself or made one of those boring practice projects they normally give beginners, but while I was thinking about what I could build, I thought, why not use Ama? 😂❤️ At least if I’m going to spend hours fighting with HTML and CSS and wondering why something has moved to the wrong side of the screen, I might as well be looking at your face while doing it.

So yes, Ama Adepa, congratulations 😂. You have officially become part of my coding journey. I decided to use what I’m learning to create this little website for you, put some of your pictures together, write something for you, and just make something beautiful that you can come back to whenever you want. I’m still learning, so don’t come and inspect my code like some professional software engineer oo 😭😂. Maybe a few years from now, when I’m much better at coding, I’ll come back to this website and laugh at some of the things I did. But I think I’ll still love what it represents because one of the first times I decided to use what I was learning to build something personal, I chose to build something for you.

So enjoy your little website, madam 😂❤️. Look at your pictures, read everything, laugh at the unnecessary things I added, and just know that somebody sat behind a laptop putting all of this together while thinking about you. It may just be HTML, CSS, some JavaScript, pictures, and words on a screen, but behind all of it is someone who genuinely cherishes you and wants to see you happy and doing well.

I really hope that next year brings good news for both of us and that someday soon we can look back at this period when I was here and you were there and laugh about how we managed it. Hopefully, I’ll get to welcome you here, we’ll finally do some of the things we’ve spent so much time talking about, we’ll go to New York during Christmas, we’ll dance like crazy people 😂, and I’ll probably remind you about this website and tell you, “See, Ama? I told you things would work out.”

Until then, keep going and keep smiling that beautiful smile of yours. Don’t let the hospital people stress my baby girl too much 😂. Do what you have to do, come home, rest, and focus on where you’re going. I’m praying for you, I’m rooting for you, and I genuinely want the very best for you.

I love you so much, Ama. ❤️

My Ama. My baby girl. My Ama Adepa. ❤️

And yes… I’m still waiting for my twins. 😂❤️

Always,
Junior ❤️
